title: Storage Yard Amenities, Gate Hours and Gate Cards — RV & Boat Storage
content:
What an RV & Boat Storage rental includes at the yard depends on its space class. The electric hookup is a 30-amp maintenance outlet at the space, used for a monthly fee; the dump station and the wash rack are included in the rental where the class lists them.

| Space class | 30-amp maintenance outlet at the space | Monthly electric hookup fee (USD) | RV dump station included | Wash rack included | Daily gate hours for renters |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Open Compact Storage Space | not available | not applicable | no | no | 06:00 to 21:00 |
| Open Standard Storage Space | not available | not applicable | yes | no | 06:00 to 21:00 |
| Open Large Storage Space | not available | not applicable | yes | yes | 06:00 to 21:00 |
| Covered Standard Storage Space | available | 18.00 | yes | yes | 05:00 to 22:00 |
| Covered Large Storage Space | available | 18.00 | yes | yes | 05:00 to 22:00 |
| Enclosed Storage Unit | available | 22.00 | yes | yes | 05:00 to 22:00 |

**Gate cards.** A lost gate card is replaced for a fee of 15.00 in every space class.

### Reading the schedule

**Which classes carry an electric hookup fee?** Only the Covered Standard Storage Space (18.00), the Covered Large Storage Space (18.00) and the Enclosed Storage Unit (22.00). The three open classes have no outlet, so no hookup fee figure exists for them.

**Do all classes open the gate at the same time?** No. The three open classes open from 06:00 to 21:00; the covered classes and the Enclosed Storage Unit open from 05:00 to 22:00.

**Is the wash rack part of every rental?** No. It is included from the Open Large Storage Space upward and not in the Open Compact or Open Standard Storage Space. The dump station is included in every class except the Open Compact Storage Space.
